# CausalInformationFiltering

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-09-19

## Definition
Selective transmission or suppression of information based on inferred causal directionality within a dynamical network. It enables TCC architectures to isolate genuine causal signals from correlated noise in complex physical reservoir dynamics.
